home.title: Holiday apartments in the middle of Saalbach

descriptions.home: Three holiday apartments for 2 to 6 guests in the centre of Saalbach, let by the week from Saturday to Saturday and booked directly with the hosts.
descriptions.about: Who lets the apartments: Firn & Farn, two houses in Saalbach rebuilt in wood from the region, with three apartments named after their woods.
descriptions.faq: Answers before and during your stay in Saalbach: booking and payment, arrival and keys, the apartment, departure and getting here.
descriptions.parking: Where to park in Saalbach: the parking spaces of our houses, and the car parks in the village centre and at the Schattberg gondola.
descriptions.imprint: The legal details of Firn & Farn Appartements GmbH in Saalbach: address, contact and company register.
descriptions.privacy: Which data this website and your booking use, who receives them and what rights you have.
descriptions.terms: The rental terms for our holiday apartments in Saalbach: booking, payment, cancellation, arrival and the house rules.
descriptions.credits: Who took the photos this website shows, under which licence, and what was changed in them.
descriptions.zirbe/arrival: How to get to Zirbe in Saalbach by car, train and bus, where to park and where the ski room is.

hero.summer: A view over an alpine meadow and spruces to the green slopes above Saalbach.
